title: Supply-Aligned Demand Shaping

engineFeatures.meaning: what has been delivered so far, seen after a delay
the demand available each step, which the controller does not control

label: For "Supply-Aligned Demand Shaping": Shape promotions and pricing to steer demand toward items and weeks where supply is plentiful, reducing stock-outs and waste. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Promo uplift from non-randomised data.
